1.w: A son [is] wise [by] the discipline of his father, and a mocker does not listen to rebuke.

2.w: From the fruit of the mouth a man eats good things, and the soul of the treacherous, violence.

3.w: One guarding his mouth is keeping his soul; one opening his lips, destruction [is] unto him.

4.w: The soul of a sluggish one is desiring, and [has] nothing; and the soul of the diligent ones is made fat.

5.w: A righteous one hates a word of falsehood, and a wicked one causes stench and shame.

6.w: Righteousness guards the one of integrity in the way, and wickedness overthrows the sinner.

7.w: There is one making himself rich and [having] nothing at all, one making himself poor and [having] abundant wealth.

8.w: His riches [are] the ransom for the soul of a man, and a poor one has not heard rebuke.

9.w: The light of the righteous rejoices, and the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.

10.w: Only with arrogance does one give forth strife, and wisdom [is] with the counseled ones.

11.w: Wealth from vanity is diminished, and the one gathering by the hand becomes great.

12.w: Hope deferred weakens the heart, and desire fulfilled [is] a tree of life.

13.w: The one despising the word is destroyed for it, and the one fearing the command, he will be rewarded.

14.w: The instruction of the wise [is] a fountain of life, to turn aside from the snares of death.

15.w: Good insight gives favor, and the way of the treacherous [is] perpetual.

16.w: Every prudent one acts with knowledge, and a fool spreads out folly.

17.w: A wicked messenger falls into evil, and an envoy of faithfulness [is] healing.

18.w: Poverty and shame [are] to one disdaining discipline, and the one regarding a rebuke is honored.

19.w: A desire coming to pass is pleasant to the soul, and turning aside from evil [is] an abomination to fools.

20.w: The one walking with wise ones will become wise, and the one accompanying fools will suffer evil.

21.w: Evil pursues the sinful ones, and goodness will reward the righteous ones.

22.w: A good one leaves an inheritance [for] the sons of his sons, and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for a righteous one.

23.w: There is much food [in] the fallow ground of the poor, and it is swept away for lack of justice.

24.w: The one withholding his rod is hating his son, and one loving him diligently seeks him with discipline.

25.w: A righteous one is eating to the satisfaction of his soul, and the belly of the wicked will be lacking.
